name: Type Of Price 13 Code
definition: Specifies the type of price and information about the price.

BIDE.name: Bid
BIDE.definition: Price is the calculated bid price of a dual-priced fund (offer-bid prices), that is, the selling price of the units for the investor.

OFFR.name: Offer
OFFR.definition: Price is the calculated offer price of a dual-priced investment fund (offer-bid prices), that is, the buying price of the units for an investor.

NAVL.name: Net Asset Value
NAVL.definition: Price is the net asset value per unit that is used either as a transacting price for a single-priced investment fund class, or as a notional price for the calculation of other prices.

CREA.name: Creation
CREA.definition: Price is the calculated creation price of a dual-priced investment fund (creation-cancellation prices) and the highest possible buying price of the units before the initial charge. The actual buying or offer price, which includes charges, will be higher.

CANC.name: Cancellation
CANC.definition: Price is the calculated cancellation price of a dual-priced investment fund (creation-cancellation price), and the lowest possible valuation of the units on any one-day. The actual selling or bid price is usually higher.

INTE.name: Interim
INTE.definition: Price is the non-official interim price given to an investor before the executed price.

SWNG.name: Swing
SWNG.definition: Price is the calculated net asset value price of a single-priced investment fund. The price is adjusted to take into account the dealing costs due to individual large deals, or due to a significant imbalance in volumes of subscriptions vs redemptions, as an alternative to dilution levy.

MIDD.name: Mid
MIDD.definition: Price is the average price between the bid and offer prices.

RINV.name: Reinvestment
RINV.definition: Price is the price used when reinvesting units after distribution.

NAVS.name: Side Pocket NAV
NAVS.definition: Price is the estimated net asset value for the side pocket.

SWIC.name: Switch
SWIC.definition: Price is the price used when transferring units between products.

GAVL.name: Gross Asset Value
GAVL.definition: Price is the gross asset value per unit and includes the performance fee per share. It is used as the transacting price for a fund with equalisation. GAVL price minus the NAVL price = performance fee.

DDVR.name: Daily Dividend Rate
DDVR.definition: Price is the net income of a financial instrument, calculated on each dealing day, and divided by all the units outstanding on that day.

EGAV.name: Estimated GAV
EGAV.definition: Price is the estimated gross asset value per unit and includes the performance fee per share. It is used as the transacting price for a fund with equalisation. GAVL price minus the NAVL price = performance fee.
